requests.name: run
requests.prompt: Hero transformation DEATH155, an armored humanoid reaper, not a skeleton: dark metallic enclosed helmet with a tall ornate steel crest and skull-like face mask, heavy dark steel shoulder/chest armor under a charcoal-black tattered heavy cloak, dark gauntlets, armored boots, a large crescent silver-steel scythe blade on a long dark brown-black shaft. Restrained cold metallic highlights, no bright gold costume, no neon or floating magic particles. Same helmet, crest, armor, cloak, scythe shape and hand grip in every sprite. Readable detailed isometric fantasy pixel art with solid opaque connected anatomy, intact hands on the scythe, clear two articulated legs. Whole figure and full long scythe fit INSIDE each square cell with generous transparent gutters. Transparent RGBA background, no floor, cast shadows, labels, text or grid. EXACT six columns by eight rows, equal square cells, preferred1536x2048. Row headings E,SE,S,SW,W,NW,N,NE. Fixed isometric camera throughout each row; back rows show the back of helmet/cloak, not the face. Consistent apparent size and projected world ground anchor. RUN ONLY, six genuinely different articulated phases: left boot contact/right leg behind; left loading/right knee forward; flight exchanging legs; right boot contact/left behind; right loading/left knee forward; second flight. Alternate hinged knees/ankles with restrained cloth follow-through, scythe held stable in both hands. No copied frames and no whole-body bobbing-only motion.48 unique run sprites.
